title: Obuggya Obw’okulya
intro: Enfumo enkadde okusinga obwakabaka oba ebyawandiikibwa byonna —ekikangabwa ky’omuntu ekyasooka okuzaalibwa obuggya. Omwoyo gumu, omukulu w’abaana babiri abazaalibwa abazadde abaasooka, yatunuulira mu busungu nga muto we afuna ekisa ekyagaanibwa. Ekyaddirira kyali kisinga okuba ekizikiza mu kulonda, ne kireka omusaayi ogwasooka okuyiibwa ku nsi. Osobola okubikkula omuntu oyo, okugezesebwa, n’okwejjusa okw’amaanyi?
clues: Nnazaalibwa abantu babiri abaasooka ennyo okutambulira ku nsi.
Lumu nakola ekiweebwayo eri Allah, naye nga tekikkirizibwa gyendi.
Ekiweebwayo muganda wange kyakkirizibwa, ate ekyange kyagaanibwa —ekintu kye nnali sisobola kugumiikiriza.
Nze nafuuka eyasooka okukola ettemu ku nsi eno, nga ntwala obulamu bwa muganda wange yennyini.
Allah yasindika ekitonde ky’ensi — ekinyonyi ekiddugavu nga kisima mu ttaka — okunjigiriza engeri y’okukweka bye nnali nkoze, era nasigala sirina kirala okuggyako okwejjusa.

outcome.label: Ebivudemu
options: Yafuuka ajjudde okwejjusa era mu baafiirwa
Yayingira mu Jjana ng’ayita mu kusaasira okw’obwakatonda
outcome.answer: Yafuuka ajjudde okwejjusa era mu baafiirwa

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
